metadata.title: Gritty Monochromatic Portrait with Expressive Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait featuring a central figure with eyes obscured by a bright, textured light-streak and aggressive, hand-drawn typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric composition centered on a male figure in low-key lighting. The eyes are obscured by a horizontal, glowing white brushstroke that mimics a motion blur or light leak. The entire image is treated with heavy film grain, dust, and scratches. Typography is expressive, appearing as if written with a thick white marker or paint pen.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the deep black background and the glowing white eye-streak.
Textural harmony between the grainy photographic subject and the rough-edged lettering.
Vertical hierarchy placing the artist name at the top and the title across the chest.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic black and white color space.
Heavy film grain and surface distress (scratches/dust).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-up portrait, filling the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white horizontal streak across the eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left lettering, moves down to the glowing eyes, and settles on the central title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black void surrounding the head and shoulders, providing high contrast for the white elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays (skin textures and film grain)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a felt-tip marker.
Rough, jagged edges with visible ink bleed or dry-brush effects.
Slanted orientation for the top text; horizontal for the bottom.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the top text has an elongated, aggressive tail.
The '>' symbol is integrated as a sharp, gestural stroke.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive script paired with spaced-out block lettering for a raw, DIY aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, immediate feel of the lettering.
Matches the energy of the top-left text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, monochromatic black and white portrait of a person in low-key lighting. Apply a heavy film grain, dust, and scratch texture. Add a bright, glowing white horizontal light-streak across the eyes that looks like a long-exposure motion blur.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, white marker-style lettering. Place a slanted script in the top left and a spaced-out block-lettering title across the center chest area. Ensure the edges of the letters are rough and distressed.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Are the eyes obscured by a bright white streak?
Does the typography look hand-drawn rather than typeset?
Is there visible film grain and surface distress?

adjustableVariables: Width and brightness of the eye-streak
mustRedesign: Any recognizable logos or brand marks
Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance.
Verify the eye-streak has a glowing, textured quality.
Ensure typography has a rough, marker-like finish.
Confirm the presence of dust and scratch overlays.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key B&W portrait + glowing eye-censor + distressed marker lettering + heavy film grain.
